target.name: PVRIG (CD112R)
target.mechanism: Inhibitory receptor on T/NK cells in the DNAM-1 (CD226) axis; blocking PVRIG reactivates anti-tumor cytotoxicity, complementary to PD-1 blockade.
evidence: PVRIG/CD112R is an emerging next-generation checkpoint with no failed Merck program attached.
Clinically explored by COM701 (anti-PVRIG), validating the target's relevance.
Complementary mechanism to anti-PD-1 (Keytruda), supporting combination strategies post-LOE.
target.recommendationText: Advance PVRIG as the lead next-gen IO target; structure-enabled antibody design recommended.
